newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Network General cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Network General cut.

text.p: -- Cowen & Co analyst Chris Stix said Tuesday he had downgraded his rating for Network General Corp to buy from strong buy.
-- Stix told Reuters he had cut the rating because of rising expenses.
-- "Basically you have lower earnings and lower earnings growth," he said. He reduced his 12-month price target for the stock to $27 from $38.
-- Shares in the Menlo Park, Calif.- based maker of computer networking products were down 4-1/2 to 13-3/8.
